scope_review.notes: Scope review: De Theologia I-XLIII closed plus De Fide I-XXII plus De Authoritate Scripturae Pars I tip I-VIII from the 1675 Pitt Latin lock. Honest partial densify — tip of Pars I only; remainder of Pars I and Parts II-IV remain; not the collected folio. Era disclosed as mid-seventeenth-century Reformed Sedan, not patristic. Grounded in sources/_le_blanc_authoritate_latin_lock.txt.
